pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   D. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   D. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   D. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.

12. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain care for plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

16. (4 marks)
